method: Predict reward by frozen context/anchor ridge, then add a shrunk request-specific residual estimated only from previously selected widths. Current feedback is applied after allocation.
hypothesis: Context prediction and recent verification feedback have complementary errors; request-specific residual correction can improve allocation even when each alone fails.
base_selection: Four ridge penalties, inner prompt-grouped MSE; four prompt-grouped outer folds. Same frozen predictor in adaptive and frozen controls.
update_selection: Inner prompt-grouped allocation reward; include no-update plus alpha .5/1, prior count 1/4, decay .5/1. Fixed enumeration tie-break. No outer label tuning.
budget: Exact DP, widths 1-8, sum widths <=3*active states at each teacher offset.
gate: Require >=10% reward over fixed3 and improvement over frozen to justify further fresh-data study; no inference-speed claim from this diagnostic.
limitations: 47 reused prompts, 277 teacher anchors; exploratory only.
Feedback at exogenous offsets8tokens apart is not closed-loop inference.
Accepted-token reward is not throughput; deployment must include all overhead.
General context-aware allocation and feedback adaptation already have prior art; novelty not established.
